{"claims":[{"claim_text":"By the early 1990s, most pundits and politicians proclaimed the ultimate triumph of neoliberalism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"By the mid-2000s, socialists and progressives in the United States and Europe could boast of virtually no examples of successful resistance to neoliberalism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"South America was practically the only democratic leftist political stronghold in the world during the mid-2000s.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The situation in Europe and the United States looked completely different a few short years after the mid-2000s, as the Left had finally galvanized significant support in the electoral arena and pulled the terms of political debate significantly leftward through creative social movement organizing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In Greece, the left-wing Syriza party came to power in 2014.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In Spain, the left-wing Podemos party emerged from anti-austerity protests in 2014 and was the third largest party in the country two years later.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Jeremy Corbyn rose to the leadership of the British Labor Party in 2015.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Bernie Sanders had a phenomenal success with his “political revolution” during the 2016 United States’ presidential election.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
